No. G1116] PORT MORESBY, MONDAY, 3rd NOVEMBER [2025

National Information and Communications Technology Act 2009

NOTICE OF MAKING OF MANDATORY INSTRUMENTS UNDER THE NATIONAL ICT ACT 2009

I, Kila Gulo-Vui, Chief Executive Officer of the National Information and Communications Technology
Authority, (also referred to as NICTA), by virtue of the powers conferred by Section 218 of the National ICT
Act 2009 and all other powers me enabling, hereby give notice of the following instrument that has been made
by NICTA pursuant to the National ICT Act 2009.

1. Regulatory Instruments:—
Consumer Complaints Management System Guideline 2025 pursuant to Section 218 of the National JCT
Act 2009.

2. Commencement
This regulatory instrument takes effect from the date published herein.

Dated this 23rd day of October, 2025.

K. GULO-VUI,
Chief Executive Officer.

Printed and Published by C. Lenturut, Government Printer,
Port Moresby.— 1116.
